attempts.summary: Created dedicated system account inventorysvc on node1, deployed /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as systemd service inventory-worker running under that account, enabled and started it, then performed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id/service health, issued systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the service auto-started (enabled) and is running as inventorysvc post-restart.
